title: 第26章 祖祭第27章 手链
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
胡隆微微皱眉。
准备将其放进口袋，但是想了想，还是将人皮放进了背包里的夹层之中。
这个东西太诡异，贴身放虽然安全，但是万一有什么副作用反而不好。
做完这一切后，他才是伸手入口袋，拿出在不断震动的手机。
来电显示是胡承文的电话。
“喂！”
“小隆，最近玩的怎么样？”
胡承文的声音传来。
“还行。”
胡隆道。
他知道，对方打过来应该不是只是为了关心他。
这段时间，对于原身家庭几人的性格他已经有了一些了解。
果不其然。
胡承文在关心询问了一番胡隆的情况后。
才说起正事。
“你玩的也差不多了，现在年关将近，祖祭过两天就要开始了，你先回来一下吧。”
胡承文的声音传来。
“祖祭？”
胡隆目光微动。
经过对方这么一说，让他想起了原身的一些零碎记忆。

的确有祖祭一说。
不过因为记忆比较残缺的原因，他所知并不详细。
就在这时，或许是提到了祖祭的事情所致，原身脑海之中残留的一幅画面记忆突兀的出现在脑海之中。
那是关于胡家本家人记忆。
或许是因为时间太过久远。
画面有些模糊。
原身只知道本家的人光是直面都能感受到巨大的压力。
那种感觉很奇特。
形容不上来，就像是面对猛兽一般。
而且，很神秘，权势极大。
就算是胡承文，对待胡家本家之人也是小心翼翼。
回想到这点。
胡隆心中微动。
这原身所在的胡家，似乎也有一些隐秘。
反正继续在外面也没有什么收获，倒不如回去看看。
想到这里，他直接答应了下来。
“好，我知道了。”
……
天幕澄澈如洗，阳光泼洒下来，将无垠的草原染成一张铺展到天际的绒绿巨毯。
content_en:
Hu Long frowned slightly.
He was about to put it in his pocket, but after thinking about it, he put the human skin into the compartment in his backpack.
This thing is too weird. Although it is safe to keep it close to the body, it would not be good if it has any side effects.
After doing all this, he reached into his pocket and took out his vibrating cell phone.
The caller ID was Hu Chengwen’s phone number.
"Hey!"
"Xiaolong, how have you been playing recently?"
Hu Chengwen's voice came.
"It's okay."
Hu Long said.
He knew that the other party probably didn't call just because he was concerned about him.
During this time, he had already gained some understanding of the personalities of his original family members.
Sure enough.
After Hu Chengwen asked about Hu Long's situation with concern.
Only then did we get down to business.
"You've almost finished playing. The New Year is approaching and the ancestor worship will begin in two days. You should come back first."
Hu Chengwen's voice came.
"Ancestor sacrifice?"
Hu Long's eyes moved slightly.
After what the other party said, he was reminded of some fragmentary memories of the original person.
There is indeed something to say about ancestor worship.
However, due to his incomplete memory, he did not know the details.
At this moment, perhaps because of the mention of the ancestor sacrifice, a memory of a picture left in the original mind suddenly appeared in his mind.
That is about the memory of the Hu family.
Maybe it's because it's been so long.
The picture is a little blurry.
The original person only knows that people in this family can feel tremendous pressure just by facing it head-on.
That feeling is very strange.
It's hard to describe, it's like facing a beast.
Moreover, it is very mysterious and extremely powerful.
Even Hu Chengwen is cautious when dealing with members of the Hu family.
Think back to this.
Hu Long's heart moved slightly.
The Hu family where the original body was located seems to have some secrets.
Anyway, there is nothing to be gained by continuing to stay outside, so it is better to go back and take a look.
Thinking of this, he directly agreed.
"Okay, I get it."
…
The sky is as clear as water, and the sunlight splashes down, dyeing the endless grassland into a giant velvet green carpet that stretches to the sky.
